description: Ruimtelijke belemmeringen en potentie voor windenergie op land is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.geocoders.nl. The Netherlands is divided into hexagones. Each hexagon offers space for one medium sized wind turbine (50 to 90 m diameter), 1.4 small wind turbines (smaller than 50 m diameter), or 0.7 large wind turbines (greater than 90 m diameter). Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Spatial barriers and potential for wind energy on land" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include wind op land, duurzame energie, windenergie, ruimtelijke ordening, duurzaamheid, energie. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
